<!-- Write the title and body in English. See https://github.com/takahirox/webgpu-devtools/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md -->

## Problem

Describe the problem and who or what it affects.

## Expected outcome

Describe what should be true when this Issue is resolved.

## Context

Add relevant examples, logs, related Issues, and environment details. For a browser or WebGPU problem, include browser, extension, OS, and GPU details when relevant.

## Reproduction steps (if applicable)

List steps to reproduce the problem, actual behavior, and expected behavior. Omit this section when it does not apply.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replace this with concrete, mandatory criteria achievable and verifiable before merge.

Default to criteria an AI agent can execute and verify. Require human confirmation, physical-device testing, subjective evaluation, or external approval only when necessary for this Issue; explain why and what result is expected. Checks possible only after merge must not be pre-merge approval conditions.

## Optional validation

List useful additional checks separately from required completion criteria, or state that none are needed.

## Required post-merge verification

Record only genuinely necessary checks that can happen only after merge, or state that none are required. Keep them pending until performed; pre-merge checks do not prove deployment or publication succeeded. See the [review guidelines](https://github.com/takahirox/webgpu-devtools/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md).
